constraintName.description:
Gets or sets the constraint name.
If not provided, a default name will be generated.

columnName.description:
Gets or sets the column name this check constraint applies to.
Optional - if not specified, the constraint applies to the table level.

checkExpression.description: Gets or sets the check constraint expression.

CheckConstraintDto.description: Data transfer object representing a check constraint.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of views.

CheckConstraintListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple check constraints.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the view data.

CheckConstraintResponse.description: Response model for check constraint operations.

columnName.description: Gets or sets the column name.

dotnetTypeName.description: Gets or sets the friendly .NET type name (e.g., "string", "int?", "Dictionary<string, object>").

providerDataType.description: Gets or sets the provider-specific data type (e.g., "VARCHAR(255)", "INTEGER", "DECIMAL(10,2)").

length.description: Gets or sets the length of the column.

precision.description: Gets or sets the precision of the column.

scale.description: Gets or sets the scale of the column.

checkExpression.description: Gets or sets the check constraint expression.

defaultExpression.description: Gets or sets the default value expression.

isNullable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is nullable.

isPrimaryKey.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is a primary key.

isAutoIncrement.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is auto-incremented.

isUnique.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is unique.

isUnicode.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column explicitly supports unicode characters.

isFixedLength.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is of a fixed length.

isIndexed.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is indexed.

isForeignKey.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the column is a foreign key.

referencedTableName.description: Gets or sets the referenced table name (if this is a foreign key).

referencedColumnName.description: Gets or sets the referenced column name (if this is a foreign key).

ColumnDto.description: Data transfer object representing a database column optimized for API responses.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of columns.

ColumnListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple columns.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the column data.

datasourceId.description: Gets or sets the datasource ID that was tested.

connected.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the connection was successful.

provider.description: Gets or sets the database provider name.

serverVersion.description: Gets or sets the database server version if available.

databaseName.description: Gets or sets the database name if available.

errorMessage.description: Gets or sets any error message if the connection failed.

responseTimeMs.description: Gets or sets the response time in milliseconds.

DatasourceConnectivityTestDto.description: Result of a datasource connectivity test.

id.description: Gets or sets the unique name identifier for this datasource.

provider.description: Gets or sets the database provider type.

connectionString.description: Gets or sets the connection string for database access.

displayName.description: Gets or sets the display name for this datasource.

description.description: Gets or sets a description of this datasource.

tags.description: Gets or sets additional tags for categorizing this datasource.

isEnabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether gets or sets whether this datasource is enabled for use.

createdAt.description: Gets the date and time when this datasource was created.

updatedAt.description: Gets the date and time when this datasource was last updated.

DatasourceDto.description:
Represents a datasource registration for DapperMatic operations.
Contains connection information and metadata for database access.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of datasources.

DatasourceListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple datasources.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the datasource data.
Gets or sets the datasource connectivity tests data.

DatasourceTestResponse.description: Response model for datasource connectivity test operations.

dataType.description: Gets or sets the data type name (e.g., "VARCHAR", "INTEGER", "DECIMAL").

aliases.description: Gets or sets any aliases for this data type.

isCommon.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a commonly used data type.

isCustom.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a custom/user-defined type.

supportsLength.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this data type supports length specification.

minLength.description: Gets or sets the minimum length for this data type (if supported).

maxLength.description: Gets or sets the maximum length for this data type (if supported).

defaultLength.description: Gets or sets the default length for this data type (if supported).

supportsPrecision.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this data type supports precision specification.

minPrecision.description: Gets or sets the minimum precision for this data type (if supported).

maxPrecision.description: Gets or sets the maximum precision for this data type (if supported).

defaultPrecision.description: Gets or sets the default precision for this data type (if supported).

supportsScale.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this data type supports scale specification.

minScale.description: Gets or sets the minimum scale for this data type (if supported).

maxScale.description: Gets or sets the maximum scale for this data type (if supported).

defaultScale.description: Gets or sets the default scale for this data type (if supported).

category.description: Gets or sets the data type category (e.g., "Numeric", "String", "DateTime", "Binary").

description.description: Gets or sets an optional description or example of the data type.

examples.description: Gets or sets example values or use cases for this data type.

DataTypeDto.description: Data transfer object for a single provider data type.

constraintName.description:
Gets or sets the constraint name.
If not provided, a default name will be generated.

columnName.description: Gets or sets the column name to apply the default constraint to.

defaultExpression.description: Gets or sets the default value expression.

DefaultConstraintDto.description: Data transfer object representing a default constraint.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of default constraints.

DefaultConstraintListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple default constraints.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the default constraint data.

DefaultConstraintResponse.description: Response model for default constraint operations.

name.description: Gets or sets the field name.

fieldType.description: Gets or sets the friendly .NET type name for the field (e.g., "String", "Int32", "List<String>").

isNullable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the field allows null values.

FieldDto.description: Represents information about a field in query results.

constraintName.description: Gets or sets the constraint name.

columnNames.description: Gets or sets the column names in this table.

referencedTableName.description: Gets or sets the referenced table name.

referencedColumnNames.description: Gets or sets the referenced column names.

onDelete.description:
Gets or sets the action to take on update.
Options: "NoAction", "Cascade", "SetNull", "SetDefault", "Restrict"

onUpdate.description:
Gets or sets the action to take on delete.
Options: "NoAction", "Cascade", "SetNull", "SetDefault", "Restrict"

ForeignKeyConstraintDto.description: Data transfer object representing a foreign key constraint.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of foreign key constraints.

ForeignKeyListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple foreign key constraints.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the foreign key constraint data.

ForeignKeyResponse.description: Response model for foreign key constraint operations.

indexName.description: Gets or sets the index name.

columnNames.description: Gets or sets the columns that make up the index.

isUnique.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the index is unique.

isClustered.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the index is clustered.

IndexDto.description: Data transfer object representing an index.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of indexes.

IndexListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple indexes.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the index data.

take.description: Gets or sets the number of records taken.

skip.description: Gets or sets the number of records skipped.

total.description: Gets or sets the total number of records (if requested).

hasMore.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether there are more records available.

totalPages.description: Gets the total number of pages (if total is available).

PaginationDto.description: Represents pagination information for query results.

constraintName.description:
Gets or sets the constraint name.
If not provided, a default name will be generated.

columnNames.description:
Gets or sets the columns that make up the primary key.
Column names can include sort order (e.g., "ColumnName ASC" or "ColumnName DESC").

PrimaryKeyConstraintDto.description: Data transfer object representing a primary key constraint.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the primary key constraint data.

PrimaryKeyResponse.description: Response model for primary key constraint operations.

providerName.description: Gets or sets the database provider name (e.g., "SqlServer", "MySQL", "PostgreSQL", "Sqlite").

result.description: Gets or sets the list of data types.

ProviderDataTypeListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple data types.

take.description: Gets or sets the number of records to take. Default is 100, max is 1000.

skip.description: Gets or sets the number of records to skip for pagination.

includeTotal.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to include the total count in the response.

orderBy.description: Gets or sets the order by clause. Format: "column1.asc,column2.desc"

filters.description:
Gets or sets the filter conditions. Dictionary where key is "column.operator" and value is the filter value.
Supported operators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, nlike, in, nin, isnull, notnull

select.description:
Gets or sets the columns to select. If null or empty, selects all columns (*).
Format: "column1,column2,column3"

schemaName.description: Gets or sets the schema name. This is set internally from the route and not by the user.

QueryDto.description: /// Request model for querying tables or views with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of query results.

pagination.description: Gets or sets the pagination information.

fields.description: Gets or sets the field information for the results.

schemaName.description: Gets or sets the schema name.

result.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the schema exists.

SchemaExistsResponse.description: Response model for checking if a schema exists.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of schemas.

SchemaListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple schemas.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the schema data.

schemaName.description: Gets or sets the schema name of the table.

tableName.description: Gets or sets the name of the table.

columns.description: Gets or sets the columns of the table.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the primary key constraint of the table.

checkConstraints.description: Gets or sets the check constraints of the table.

defaultConstraints.description: Gets or sets the default constraints of the table.

uniqueConstraints.description: Gets or sets the unique constraints of the table.

foreignKeyConstraints.description: Gets or sets the foreign key constraints of the table.

indexes.description: Gets or sets the indexes of the table.

TableDto.description:
Data transfer object representing a database table optimized for API responses.
Properties are nullable to support partial updates via PUT/PATCH operations.

result.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the table exists.

TableExistsResponse.description: Response model for checking if a table exists.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of tables.

TableListResponse.description: Response model for table list operations.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the table data.

constraintName.description:
Gets or sets the constraint name.
If not provided, a default name will be generated.

columnNames.description:
Gets or sets the columns that make up the unique constraint.
Column names can include sort order (e.g., "ColumnName ASC" or "ColumnName DESC").

UniqueConstraintDto.description: Data transfer object representing a unique constraint.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of unique constraints.

UniqueConstraintListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple unique constraints.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the unique constraint data.

UniqueConstraintResponse.description: Response model for unique constraint operations.

schemaName.description: Gets or sets the schema name of the view.

viewName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the view.
Required for create operations, optional for updates (used for rename when different from route parameter).

definition.description:
Gets or sets the definition of the view.
Required for create operations, optional for updates.

ViewDto.description:
Data transfer object for view information.
Properties are nullable to support partial updates via PUT/PATCH operations.

result.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the view exists.

ViewExistsResponse.description: Response model for checking if a view exists.

result.description: Gets or sets the list of views.

ViewListResponse.description: Response model for listing multiple views.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the view data.
